description: Quanta Services, Inc. is a leading provider of comprehensive infrastructure solutions for the electric and gas utility, power generation, large load center, manufacturing, communications, pipeline and energy industries in the United States, Canada, Australia and select other international markets. It provides design, engineering, procurement, construction, upgrade and repair and maintenance services for infrastructure within each of these industries, including electric power transmission and distribution networks, substation facilities, wind, solar and gas power generation and transmission and battery storage facilities, low voltage electrical, mechanical, plumbing and process infrastructure for large load centers such as data center, advanced manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceutical and industrial facilities, communications and cable multi-system operator networks, gas utility systems, pipeline transmission systems and facilities, and downstream industrial facilities, and its operations are decentralized.
